descriptions.d17c_rain_splash_init_800f26a8: Load the "Particle.RainSplash" mesh into the water owner's mesh slot (+28, retained, previous released), read the "Water.Level" setting into +1040, allocate 50 splashes, clear their flags, set each UV pair to 0.1 and colour to (255,255,255,200), and store the engine context tick at +1036.
